delta: Only packet publication tail uses CPU-ring low-water indication; v3 publication-aware ownership wait is byte-identical. Diagnostic label updated.
pointer_proof: SDK stream reservation checks capacity without advancing _gpu_wrptr. ring_write and ring_commit advance both staged-word count and reserved byte cursor by exactly the words stored.
In CPU-ring mode, published cursor equals (_gpu_wrptr-4*_gpu_cmd_words)&mask; completed flush has synchronously stored every staged word before publishing and clearing staged count.
GPU_RING_RDPTR returns bridge input upload_rdptr in bytes, so subtracting it from published cursor modulo mask yields offered input backlog, not expanded raster backlog.
Formula is evaluated only in CPU-ring mode below normal512word threshold with no staged sync token. DMA fallback remains unconditional publication; sync and threshold paths retain SDK semantics.
The strict threshold512bytes means fewer than128 ingress words. Unsigned arithmetic and mask preserve wrap; no unused reserved cursor gap exists at the complete packet boundary.
Input words are a feeding heuristic, not remaining GPU work: a small marker expands into a larger packet. Speed requires the fresh same-ELF native pair.
liveness: All v3 raw-owner publication escape paths remain unchanged; force-before-credit-wait ensures progress if delayed markers own older queue capacity.
